traditions.VUL: In odórem suavitátis suscípiam vos ,
traditions.KJV: I will accept you with your sweet savour ,

41.english_reference: when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered

traditions.WLC: בְּ הוֹצִיאִ֤ י אֶתְ כֶם֙ מִן הָ֣ עַמִּ֔ים וְ קִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְ כֶ֔ם מִן הָ֣ אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: cum edúxero vos de pópulis , et congregávero vos de terris , in quas dispérsi estis ,
traditions.KJV: when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered ;

41.english_reference: and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen

traditions.WLC: וְ נִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֥י בָ כֶ֖ם לְ עֵינֵ֥י הַ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.VUL: et sanctificábor in vobis in óculis natiónum .
traditions.KJV: and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .

42.english_reference: And ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et sciétis quia ego Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: And ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

42.english_reference: when I shall bring you into the land of Israel

traditions.WLC: בַּ הֲבִיאִ֥ י אֶתְ כֶ֖ם אֶל אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: cum indúxero vos ad terram Israel ,
traditions.KJV: when I shall bring you into the land of Israel ,

42.english_reference: into the country [ for ] the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers

traditions.WLC: אֶל הָ אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔ י לָ תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ הּ לַ אֲבֽוֹתֵי כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: in terram , pro qua levávi manum meam ut darem eam pátribus vestris .
traditions.KJV: into the country [ for ] the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers .

43.english_reference: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings

traditions.WLC: וּ זְכַרְתֶּם שָׁ֗ם אֶת דַּרְכֵי כֶם֙ וְ אֵת֙ כָּל עֲלִיל֣וֹתֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Et recordabímini ibi viárum vestrárum , et ómnium scélerum vestrórum ,
traditions.KJV: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִטְמֵאתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: quibus pollúti estis in eis :
traditions.KJV: wherein ye have been defiled ;

43.english_reference: and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed

traditions.WLC: וּ נְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּ פְנֵי כֶ֔ם בְּ כָל רָעוֹתֵי כֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et displicébitis vobis in conspéctu vestro , in ómnibus malítiis vestris , quas fecístis .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .

44.english_reference: And ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et sciétis quia ego Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: And ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

44.english_reference: when I have wrought with you for my name ’s sake

traditions.WLC: בַּ עֲשׂוֹתִ֥ י אִתְּ כֶ֖ם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑ י
traditions.VUL: cum benefécero vobis propter nomen meum ,
traditions.KJV: when I have wrought with you for my name ’s sake ,

44.english_reference: not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings

traditions.WLC: לֹא֩ כְ דַרְכֵי כֶ֨ם הָ רָעִ֜ים וְ כַ עֲלִילֽוֹתֵי כֶ֤ם הַ נִּשְׁחָתוֹת֙
traditions.VUL: et non secúndum vias vestras malas , neque secúndum scélera vestra péssima
traditions.KJV: not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings ,

44.english_reference: O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.VUL: domus Israel , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord GOD .
